idea: app for people who rv across the united states

brand.name: Roamstead
brand.tagline: The ultimate co-pilot for life on the open road.
brand.audience: Full-time digital nomads and active retirees navigating the US in Class A and Class B motorhomes.
brand.visualConcept: A modern digital field guide inspired by vintage WPA National Park posters, featuring tactile textures, warm organic tones, and bold retro-tinged typography.
brand.layout: A single-page narrative flow that mimics a road trip: starting with a wide scenic hero shot, transitioning into a dashboard preview 'instrument' layout, and ending with an interactive community map 'campfire' section.
creativeNotes: Use SVG path animations to trace winding scenic routes on the interactive map mockups as the user scrolls down the page.
Implement a subtle CSS grain texture overlay across the background to evoke a printed, tactile field-guide feel without sacrificing performance.
Build custom interactive UI toggles that resemble vintage dashboard switches and analog dials for the maintenance tracker preview section.
